turns.message: I have a big negotiation coming up next month and I'm nervous about it.

It's a renewal with our largest packaging supplier. Our volume with them has doubled since we signed, they opened at a 9 percent price increase, and I've had a good six-year relationship with their account manager. My CFO wants me to threaten to switch suppliers, but switching would take us about four months to qualify a new vendor.
My goals: land under a 4 percent increase, sign this quarter, and keep our priority production slots. I can offer a two-year term and act as a reference account as sweeteners.
